summary: pgx là driver và toolkit PostgreSQL cho Go, cung cấp kết nối trực tiếp với tính năng batch operation và quản lý connection pool.
usecases: High-performance Go applications needing direct PostgreSQL connectivity
Batch inserting large datasets efficiently in microservices or data pipelines
Managing database connections and transactions in server-side Go applications
ideas: Use with Go's context and sync packages for scalable concurrent database access
Leverage pgx's session pooling for connection management in web servers
Combine with custom SQL queries while maintaining Go's type safety
